name: HKDAP
oneLiner: HKDAP is Anchorpoint's pre-launch HKD stablecoin, licensed by the HKMA in April 2026 and planned as 1:1 backed by segregated high-quality liquid reserves.
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets held in segregated accounts under HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance requirements

launchPhaseDetail: HKMA-licensed stablecoin issuer FRS01, effective April 10 2026; JV between Standard Chartered, HKT, and Animoca Brands; 1:1 backed by HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets. On May 13 2026, Anchorpoint, OSL Group, and PantherTrade completed a full-lifecycle test transfer on Ethereum mainnet (fiat funding, reserve, mint, transfer, full redemption) without putting tokens into circulation — confirming Ethereum as the deployment chain. The original end-of-Q2 2026 phased rollout target closed on June 30, 2026 with no public circulating token. On July 21 2026 Caixin reported, citing people familiar with the plans, that Anchorpoint will launch HKDAP within the month with distribution through licensed exchanges OSL and HashKey, which are already testing payment and fund use cases. The July window then closed without a launch: on August 3 2026 Standard Chartered CEO (HK) Mary Huen said work continues since the April licence, public-blockchain testing is ongoing, and the HKDAP launch announcement is now expected within August 2026, with a B2B2C distributor model whose distributor list follows the formal launch. Pharos keeps the H2 2026 window; the August date remains issuer-adjacent but unconfirmed by an Anchorpoint press release.

milestones.title: Caixin reports HKDAP launch planned within July, distributed via OSL and HashKey
milestones.description: Citing people familiar with the matter, Caixin reports Anchorpoint will launch HKDAP this month, with licensed exchanges OSL Group and HashKey Exchange distributing it and already testing online-payment and digital-asset-fund use cases. A joint Standard Chartered / Anchorpoint announcement is said to be roughly two weeks out. No official issuer confirmation and no deployment contract address published.
